Demand_Backlog.name: Demand and Backlog

B3.name: very_strong_cooling
B3.criteria: backlog YoY >=75% AND sequential backlog change <0%

B4.name: very_strong_accelerating
B4.criteria: backlog YoY >=75% AND sequential backlog change >=0%

current_evidence: Backlog +96.9% YoY, but -6.9% vs Q1 2026 and -3.1% vs Q4 2025.
Demand_Backlog.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

Margin_Quality.name: Margin Quality

M0.name: weak
M0.criteria: gross margin <25% OR adjusted EBITDA margin <10%

M1.name: normal
M1.criteria: gross margin >=25% and <30% AND EBITDA margin >=10%

M2.name: strong
M2.criteria: gross margin >=30% and <32% AND EBITDA margin >=14%

M3.name: high
M3.criteria: gross margin >=32% AND adjusted EBITDA margin >=16%

current_evidence: Gross margin 31.5%; adjusted EBITDA C$53.247M / C$324.802M = 16.39%.
Margin_Quality.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

Cash_Conversion.name: Cash Conversion and Working Capital

C1.name: stretched
C1.criteria: quarterly CFO <=0 OR working capital/sales >=15% and <20%

C2.name: stress
C2.criteria: quarterly CFO < -5% of sales OR working capital/sales >=20%

C3.name: recovered
C3.criteria: quarterly CFO >0 for 2 quarters AND working capital/sales <15%

current_evidence: Q2 cash used in operations C$6.4M; working capital declined to 17.7% of sales.
Cash_Conversion.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

AEG_Integration.name: AEG Integration

I1.name: closed_not_consolidated
I1.criteria: transaction closed but no full-quarter AEG results yet

I2.name: integration_on_track
I2.criteria: AEG full-quarter revenue disclosed and combined adjusted EBITDA margin >=12%

I3.name: integration_strain
I3.criteria: combined adjusted EBITDA margin <10% OR integration costs >5% of quarterly sales for 2 quarters

I4.name: integrated_scale
I4.criteria: AEG included for >=4 quarters AND combined adjusted EBITDA margin >=15%

current_evidence: AEG acquisition closed 2026-06-29 for about C$365M; Q2 excludes AEG revenue/costs; Q3 will include full quarter and associated debt.
AEG_Integration.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

US_DataCenter_Exposure.name: US/Data-Center Exposure
current_evidence: US & Mexico sales +73.0% YoY; management cites data-centre shipments as main driver.
US_DataCenter_Exposure.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

FX_Tariff_Execution.name: FX and Tariff Execution

T0.name: unmanaged
T0.criteria: gross margin <28% while tariff/FX headwinds are cited

T2.name: managed
T2.criteria: gross margin >=30% while price actions offset tariff pressure

T3.name: durably_managed
T3.criteria: gross margin >=31% for 2 quarters while tariff pressure persists

current_evidence: Gross margin 31.5%; company says pricing actions offset direct/indirect tariff input costs; USD/CAD Q2 rate weakened 0.4% YoY.
FX_Tariff_Execution.verification_rule: Use cited primary facts; numeric state thresholds are model_assumption.

HYPERSCALER_CAPEX.rationale: Data-centre buildout directly supports transformer/power-quality demand; taxonomy link is dependency_not_share_binding.

DATA_CENTER_POWER.rationale: Power-density/infrastructure investment expands demand; not a business-share driver.

ACQUISITION_INTEGRATION.rationale: AEG integration is material to future mix and margin; integration failure remains a failure mode.

TAIWAN_SUPPLY.rationale: Electronics/power-conversion components can face supply disruption; magnitude kept -1 because HPS transformer manufacturing is geographically diversified.
